snippet.title: StarRupture - PC Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce that StarRupture will debut in PC Early Access on January 6th, 2026.
For more information, please visit our Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/?utm_source=YT_ea_release_date_trailer

Follow the game on Steam and your favorite social media to be the first to know about our future news for StarRupture:
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/StarRupture
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/StarRupture/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/starrupture/
- Discord: https://discord.gg/starrupture
